{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|&hellip;and Amaiza, well&mdash;I've seen her shoot the antennae off a ji-ant at 600 yards!|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 9">[[Star Wars (1977) 9|''Star Wars'' (1977) 9]]</ref>}}
A '''ji-ant''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insect/Legends|insect]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once witnessed [[Amaiza Foxtrain/Legends|Amaiza Foxtrain]] shoot the antennae off a ji-ant at 600 yards, and was thus impressed by her skill with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].
